Restore Google Takeout photos

Files are read straight from the zip archives. Source files are not modified.

Sources

Add folders of takeout-*.zip archives, individual zip files, or already extracted folders. Duplicates across exports are removed automatically.

Drop folders or zip files here, or use the buttons below.

    Where to save

    Album folders use hard links when possible (no extra disk space). Free space needed is about the size of the photos.

    Restore

    Pause freezes the job in place; Stop ends it — Start again continues from saved progress.

    Thumbnails appear during restore for common image formats.
